lines.zh: 我悬在末地的空中巡游
lines.en: I cruise through the air of the End.
One beat of my wings and I glide.

lines.zh: 荒凉的岛屿在我脚下退
lines.en: The barren isles slide past beneath me.
I follow the chain of isles, searching.

lines.zh: 我的外壳在紫光里很亮
lines.en: My shell is bright in the violet light.
Low, I skim over the black stone.

lines.zh: 我绕开末地水晶的方位
lines.en: I keep clear of the crystal's position.

lines.zh: 每一步都带着金属的回音
lines.en: Every movement carries a metal echo.
I don't land. Landing is trouble.
Something is moving ahead.
I fly at an angle, avoiding open ground.
Debris slips around my body.
I hover, utterly still.
Light travels across my shell.
I listen to the End's low hum.
My wings spread, holding the air.
There's no breath in me.
This construct has no need for rest.
I turn my head to the other side.
A soft click comes from my joints.

lines.zh: 紫色的雾从底下升上来
lines.en: Violet mist rises from below.
I'm calculating the next stretch.
No sound, and no wind.
My shadow falls on the black stone.
You've entered these empty isles.
I tilt my head and scan your outline.
You aren't of the End.

lines.zh: 我抬手，比对了一下距离
lines.en: I raise a hand and measure the range.
The thing in your hand looks familiar.
I hover above you in silence.
This place will swallow you.

lines.zh: 我的外壳缝里透出冷光
lines.en: Cold light leaks from my seams.
You retreat; I don't move.
You look a little like one of mine.
A few steps closer and I'll have my answer.
The air here is not kind to you.

lines.zh: 我把视线从你身上移开
lines.en: I take my gaze off you.
Standing there, you're conspicuous.
A crack appears in my shell.
I pull back and re-hover.

lines.zh: 关节发出刺耳的摩擦声
lines.en: My joints grind harshly.
Some of my plating has failed.
I drop lower to cut the exposure.
Cold light leaks from the breach.
My response lags by half a second.
Even a construct can break.
I adjust my center of gravity.
Continued operation remains possible.

lines.zh: 能量电池才是我的食粮。
lines.en: Energy cells are my only food.
This construct knows no hunger.
You hold that up for me?
I look for two seconds, then away.
I don't accept your offerings.
This has nothing to do with me.
Lower your hand.
What I want isn't on the ground.
That isn't energy.
Keep it. You'll have use for it.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我的外壳
lines.en: Your shoulder met my shell.
I rise slightly to avoid you.
There's no spare room around here.
We missed each other by half a block.
I drop a short way, then stop.
Where you touched is very cold.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一展，末地风就起。
lines.en: My wings spread and the End wind rises.
Kindly shift aside.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的光，是亚金烧的。
lines.en: The light on my wings is Argent burning.
This isn't a conflict.

lines.zh: 我们不由这种方式产生
lines.en: We aren't made that way.
Constructs have no such need.
My kind are all up above.

lines.zh: 末地外岛来的，别问这个。
lines.en: I came from the End's outer islands, ask something else.
I keep company with no one.

lines.zh: 我只是执行我该做的事
lines.en: I only carry out what I must.
Stand off. Don't disturb me.
Your question has no answer from me.
I won't remember this exchange.
You may go.
I pinch it between my fingers.

lines.zh: 末地外岛的亚金能量，归我。
lines.en: Argent energy on the End islands is mine.
I scan its surface once.
I toss it aside.
Its composition is unremarkable.
I'll keep it for comparison.

lines.zh: 这具金属骨头用不上它。
lines.en: My metal bones have no use for it.
I take it, steadily.
This one has value.
I take nothing unnecessary.
I detect a heat source.
The height is right. Within range.
It hasn't noticed me.
I turn my body toward it.
There's a living signal in this sector.
I rise a little for a clearer view.
It's walking along the ridge.
Target in range. Locked.
My muzzle is already glowing.
It's below me. Perfect.
I begin calculating the angle.
It's still coming this way.
I hold this altitude.
It moves; my aim follows.
I wait for it to reach open ground.
Its path is very straight.
I set my shell to a cooling state.
Range is right; no need to close.
It hesitates. That's fine.
My joints lock to the angle.

lines.zh: 我的光弧扫过这条走廊。
lines.en: My arc of light sweeps the corridor.
Wind has no effect here.

lines.zh: 我判断它下一步会往左
lines.en: I predict it will step left.
It goes left, as predicted.
Now there's no reason to wait.
My power is rising.
Final correction.
I discharge a beam.
Light passes between my plates.
It's hit and staggers back.
I add a second shot.
My close attack is only a shove.
It grabs for me and misses.
I rise clear of its hands.
The black stone pits under the hit.
I descend again, closing in.
Its movements are slowing.
I keep the pressure on.
No more is needed.
My light blade sweeps across its side.
It's pinned against the black stone.
I emerge from the violet mist.
My shell lights up plate by plate.

lines.zh: 这片空岛比资料里更荒
lines.en: These isles are emptier than the records say.
First I calibrate my bearings.
Wings open, I lift off.
There are no usable facilities below.
I begin scanning the surroundings.

lines.zh: 末地的低鸣爬进我的壳
lines.en: The End's hum creeps into my shell.
I record this terrain.

lines.zh: 我朝最近的活动信号去
lines.en: I head for the nearest activity.
My joints turn for the first time.
Violet particles circle me.
I have no orders here.
The heat turns my shell red.
I lose lift and slam down hard.
Liquid floods my joints.
The blast peels back my plating.
Something sharp lodges in my shell.
An unknown field disrupts me.
My energy reserves are draining.
Current runs through my shell.
My wings can't grip the void.
